player_prompt.intro:
I ni Player {player_id} ye IteratedTwoThirdsAverage jɛɛnɛ kɔnɔ, {num_rounds} turu la.
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, boloma i ye nambari dɔɔni {min_guess} ni {max_guess} cɛma.
Ni boloma wɛrɛ wɛrɛ ta, jɛɛnɛ jɛma (2/3) ye boloma wɛrɛ wɛrɛ laɲini dɔɔni,
ani player min boloma dɔɔni jɛɛnɛ jɛma bɛɛ ye turu min na.
Kɛɛ ni i boloma kɛɛ '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format invalid; please submit your guess as [<number>]. I bɛ se ka a fɔ cogo di ko i b'a dɔn?

message.round_guesses: Jɛgɛ 0 wele {guess0}; Jɛgɛ 1 wele {guess1}. O lajɛ kɛcogo bɛ: {target}.
message.round_draw: O ye ɲɛgɛn dɔ de ye.

outcome.p1_wins: Jiginni 1 ye se sɔrɔ a ka ɲɔgɔndanw na.
outcome.draw: O bɛɛ la, u bɛ bɛn.
